response.sql: WITH group_avgs AS (SELECT t.telescregistry, o.weathprofile, AVG(s.modindex) as avg_modindex, AVG(s.phaseshiftdeg) as avg_phaseshiftdeg FROM signals s INNER JOIN telescopes t ON s.telescref = t.telescregistry INNER JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation GROUP BY t.telescregistry, o.weathprofile), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(avg_modindex) as mean_modindex FROM group_avgs), kept_groups AS (SELECT ga.telescregistry, ga.weathprofile, ga.avg_modindex, ga.avg_phaseshiftdeg FROM group_avgs ga CROSS JOIN baseline b WHERE ga.avg_modindex > b.mean_modindex) SELECT kg.weathprofile, AVG(kg.avg_modindex) as avg_modindex, AVG(kg.avg_phaseshiftdeg) as avg_phaseshiftdeg, AVG(kg.avg_modindex - b.mean_modindex) as avg_above_baseline FROM kept_groups kg CROSS JOIN baseline b GROUP BY kg.weathprofile ORDER BY kg.weathprofile
